annotations.text:
The whole idea:
if you can use Excalidraw, you can use Flowy.

- one canvas, cards and arrows
- 5 tools, nothing else in the chrome
- cards open IN PLACE - no side panel, no tabs
- one accent color means exactly one thing: your turn
- jargon becomes verbs: foreach -> checklist, gate -> your call, stale -> needs a refresh

Removed vs. today's UI:
toolbar buttons, run selector, 6 tabs, log drawer, edit-graph mode.

Where it went: run lives top-right, versions live under a corner flip on each card, the log only appears when something fails, connecting is just drawing an arrow.

Tradeoff to accept:
power features (traces, versions, cost detail) move one click deeper - a small 'i' on each card. The canvas stays calm; the depth is still there for debugging.
